title: Bidirectional contract — drive and assert ONE contract identifier in a single scenario (VION-129)
description: PlantBlock binds IPlantControl, a contract carrying BOTH wire directions under one identifier: its handler declares [ScenarioWire(Inbound = ..., Outbound = ...)] while the contract type declares no Consumers, so it classifies as an INPUT. serviceProviderSet drives the inbound demand (a bool, an enum-by-name, and a 1-level nested PlantSupply struct); the block surfaces the fields as service properties; its [Timer(1)] publishes the outbound measurement back on the SAME contract, and serviceProviderExpect asserts that multi-field command one scalar at a time with `field`, leaving the wall-clock `timestamp` unasserted.

steps.label: drive the INBOUND half of the bidirectional contract
wait until the block observes the demand
the enum field deserialized by name
a nested-struct field reached the block
fire the [Timer(1)] so the block publishes the measurement back
assert the OUTBOUND half of the SAME contract
a scalar field of the multi-field command
and a relational comparator on another field
